system.description:
• A defensive school rooted in the Jinia Isles' boarding-action tradition — built for fights on moving ships where a misstep means the sea. Counter-attack, misdirection, making your opponent's aggression work against them.
  • Serpent's Guard: +2 to your Parry checks (meeting the attack roll already succeeds).
  • Read the Blade: Advantage on Acrobatics checks involving moving surfaces (ship decks, rooftops, rope bridges) and on Insight checks reading an opponent's fighting style mid-combat.
